# `grep`

> Profile: core · Permission key: `[permission] grep`

Search file contents with regex (ripgrep engine, in-process — no `rg` binary). Respects .gitignore; skips binaries and heavy dirs (target, node_modules, .git, …). Literal queries prune files via the workspace content index before scanning. Prefer over shell grep for project code search. Hits are `path:line tag:text` so `edit` can name the line by tag.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `case_insensitive` | boolean | no | Case-insensitive match (default: false) |
| `context` | integer | no | Lines of context before/after each match (default: 0, max: 5) |
| `include` | string | no | File glob filter (e.g. '*.rs', '*.{ts,tsx}') |
| `max_results` | integer | no | Maximum number of matching lines (default: 50) |
| `path` | string | no | Directory or file to search in (default: project root) |
| `pattern` | string | yes | Regex pattern to search for |
